description_en: The shared key feature of Bastionhost allows you to store private keys used for host logon in Bastionhost. After being stored, a private key can be shared across multiple host accounts to improve host account management efficiency
description_zh: 堡垒机的共享密钥功能可以将用于登录主机的私钥托管在堡垒机中。托管后的私钥可以被共享到多个主机账户中，从而提高主机账户的管理效率
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-host-share-key --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-share-key-name name --biz-private-key LBYTnpR3Jmd2hMbmNBMGRmdWV2RW5oVXpCUmp3VkM0dGoKa0J2QlNRSHU2bytrMFBudlZvdlMzdGlBbXo5NkRzdUJDcDFFZVFJREFRQUJBb0lCQUNPZGNjK0lGUnNJd3VkYQpjT3VOSm5SK1BxWnlNZGVIaWFOcDc4SUxFd2NLZDNMZmlUWlYxc0d2Q21uTW0vQ3ZiS2NrZ0U1VjZxQVExRGZQCnI000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateHostShareKey

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host. 
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。 
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host. 
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。 
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the host shared key to create. Maximum length: 128 characters
parameters.help_zh: 要新增的主机共享密钥名称。最大长度128字符
parameters.name: host_share_key_name

parameters.help_en:
The private key (Base64-encoded string).
RSA keys and Ed25519 keys generated by using the ssh-keygen command are supported
parameters.help_zh:
私钥（Base64编码后的字符串）。
支持输入使用ssh-keygen命令生成的RSA密钥和Ed25519密钥
parameters.name: private_key

parameters.help_en: The passphrase of the private key (Base64-encoded string)
parameters.help_zh: 私钥口令（Base64编码后的字符串）
parameters.name: pass_phrase

HostShareKeyId.description_en: The ID of the host shared key

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
